content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR? But easiest is to get IR spectra which shows C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. However we need count. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But we need to know the compound. No SMILES provided. Perhaps the system expects we request IR spectra and infer number of carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool.
